parents.title: For Parents
parents.subtitle: Everything on this page was written by parents, for parents

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Get in touch with us
contact.remainder:
Have a quick question?

If you have any questions, comments, or concerns, please feel free to reach out to us at contact@pnwcubing.com

Want to organize a competition?

Competitions are not centrally organized and are rather organized by individuals willing to help

If you are interested in organizing a competition, please check out our Delegates, identify your local delegate and reach out to them.

cards.title: Competitions
cards.body: We host competitions throughout the year. Check out our upcoming competitions and past results.

cards.title: PNW Cubing Facebook Group
cards.body: If you or a parent have a Facebook account, we’d highly recommend joining our Facebook group to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they’re announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area.

cards.title: Subscribe to the PNW Monthly Newsletter!
cards.body: Your email will not be distributed to anyone. It will only be used for the PNW Monthly Newsletter.
